title: Best Accounting Software for Freelancers in India (2026)
summary: Compare the best accounting software for freelancers in India. Explore GST invoices, expense tracking, TDS, payments, pricing and key features.
body_markdown:
Freelancers often handle client projects, invoices, expenses and payments without a dedicated accounts team. As income grows, spreadsheets become harder to maintain, especially when clients deduct TDS, delay payments or pay in foreign currencies.


The **best accounting software for freelancers in India** should do more than create invoices. It should help record income, categorise expenses, track outstanding payments, prepare GST-related reports and organise financial records.


In 2026, options worth evaluating include GimBooks, Zoho Books, Refrens, Vyapar and TallyPrime. The right choice depends on your work, clients and accounting requirements.


## **Key Takeaways**


- Choose software that manages income, expenses and payments together.
- Check GST invoicing and reporting capabilities where applicable.
- Prioritise TDS reconciliation, financial reports and accountant access.
- International freelancers should verify multi-currency and export-invoice functionality.
- Compare plan limits and test real transactions before subscribing.


## **What Is Accounting Software for Freelancers?**


**Freelance accounting software** helps independent professionals organise financial transactions, track business expenses, monitor receivables and generate accounting reports.


Unlike a basic invoice generator, accounting software can show whether a client has paid, which expenses relate to a project and how much income remains after business costs.


For example, a designer earning ₹80,000 from different clients should be able to record invoices, software subscriptions, internet costs and customer payments in an organised system.

## **Which Accounting Software Should Freelancers Choose?**


### **1. GimBooks — For Everyday Billing and Bookkeeping**


GimBooks is an Indian GST billing and accounting platform that supports invoices, expenses, customer ledgers, payment reminders and business reports.


Its mobile and web access may suit consultants, designers and freelancers who manage payments between client assignments.


It is worth evaluating when straightforward billing and bookkeeping matter more than advanced project accounting.


### **2. Zoho Books — For Detailed Accounting**


Zoho Books provides expense management, bank reconciliation, financial reports, GST-related workflows and project accounting tools.


It is suitable for freelancers managing multiple projects or requiring deeper accounting records.


A free plan is available subject to eligibility and usage limits. Advanced capabilities depend on the selected plan.


### **3. Refrens — For Client-Focused Professionals**


Refrens offers invoicing, accounting, expenses and payment management.


Its service-oriented workflows make it relevant to freelancers managing quotations, client relationships and project-related costs.


Verify which accounting and multi-currency capabilities are included in your selected plan.


### **4. Vyapar — For Simple GST Accounting**


Vyapar supports GST invoicing, expenses and business financial records.


It can suit freelancers who want a straightforward billing workflow without adopting a complex accounting system.


Check device compatibility, data export and subscription limits.


### **5. TallyPrime — For Accountant-Led Bookkeeping**


TallyPrime supports financial accounting, GST, TDS, bank reconciliation and reporting.


It may be appropriate when a freelancer works closely with an accountant who already maintains records in Tally.


However, professionals requiring only occasional invoices may not need its accounting depth.


## **What Features Should Freelance Accounting Software Have?**


### **Income, Expense and Payment Tracking**


Reliable **bookkeeping software for freelancers** should record invoices, expenses, receipts and pending payments.


Look for expense categories, customer balances and profit-and-loss reports.


### **GST Invoices and Tax Reports**


**GST accounting software for freelancers** should support applicable invoice fields, SAC codes and tax calculations.


Registered freelancers should also check whether GST data can be reviewed and exported for return preparation.


For invoice requirements, see the[GST invoice mandatory fields checklist](https://www.gimbooks.com/blog/gst-invoice-mandatory-fields-rule-46-checklist/) .


### **Bank Reconciliation and TDS Records**


Bank reconciliation compares accounting entries with bank transactions.


Freelancers should also track tax deducted at source (TDS) by clients and distinguish gross invoice income from actual bank receipts.


### **Client and Project Management**


Consultants and developers may need milestone invoices, project-wise expenses or timesheets.


Confirm these features during a trial rather than assuming every accounting application supports them.


## **Why TDS and Payment Reconciliation Matter**


Suppose a freelancer invoices ₹50,000 in professional fees, excluding any applicable GST.


The client transfers ₹45,000 and reports ₹5,000 as TDS.


The freelancer should not automatically record only ₹45,000 as revenue. The accounts must distinguish the gross fee, TDS credit and bank receipt.


These amounts are illustrative, not a prescribed TDS rate.


Check relevant tax credits against Form 26AS and the Annual Information Statement (AIS). Not every software product handles TDS reconciliation automatically.


For client collections, this[guide to sharing GST invoices on WhatsApp](https://www.gimbooks.com/blog/how-to-share-gst-invoice-on-whatsapp/) explains invoice sharing and payment reminders.


## **What About GST and International Freelance Clients?**


Freelancers must determine whether GST registration applies based on their turnover, supply type and other relevant conditions.


Registered professionals need appropriate invoices and returns.


Services supplied to overseas clients may qualify as exports and zero-rated supplies when the statutory conditions are satisfied. The treatment can involve a Letter of Undertaking (LUT) or payment of IGST with the applicable refund procedure.


For overseas work, evaluate foreign-currency invoicing, exchange differences, bank charges and supporting records. Do not assume every software plan includes these functions.


For income tax, eligible professionals may consider presumptive taxation under Section 44ADA, subject to specified professions, limits and conditions. Freelance status alone does not establish eligibility.

## **How GimBooks Can Help Indian Freelancers**


GimBooks brings GST invoices, expense recording, customer ledgers, payment reminders and business reports into a single billing and accounting platform.


Its mobile and web interfaces can help independent professionals access records across supported devices.


The platform also offers purchase records and GST-related reporting workflows.


Freelancers requiring automated bank feeds, complex project accounting, dedicated TDS reconciliation or foreign-currency features should confirm availability before selecting a plan.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **What is the best accounting software for freelancers in India?**


GimBooks, Zoho Books, Refrens, Vyapar and TallyPrime are options worth evaluating. The best choice depends on GST requirements, expense tracking, project complexity and accountant preferences.


### **Is free accounting software suitable for freelancers?**


Yes, for basic requirements. Check invoice limits, accounting reports, data exports and whether important features require upgrading.


### **Do freelancers need GST accounting software?**


Only where GST registration or related obligations apply. Non-registered freelancers can still benefit from income, expense and payment tracking.


### **Can accounting software track freelancer expenses?**


Yes. Many platforms support expense recording and categorisation, helping freelancers monitor spending and prepare financial records.


### **Can freelancers use accounting software for TDS?**


They can maintain relevant income, deduction and receipt records. Dedicated TDS features vary, and tax credits should be verified against official statements.


### **Which accounting software works for international freelancers?**


Look for multi-currency invoices, exchange-rate handling, export records and reconciliation. Verify each feature and its plan availability.


### **Is GimBooks suitable for freelance professionals?**


GimBooks can suit freelancers requiring GST billing, expense records, customer ledgers and payment tracking. Advanced accounting requirements should be checked during a trial.


## **Conclusion**


The **best accounting software for freelancers in India** should organise more than invoices. It should provide visibility into income, expenses, payments and the financial records needed for applicable tax obligations.


For Indian freelancers wanting accessible GST billing and everyday bookkeeping, GimBooks is one option to evaluate.
